schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Go modules move as one graph; a grouped PR keeps go.sum coherent and matches 'one dependency bump per week'.
Actions are pinned by full commit SHA with the release tag in a trailing comment (PLAN.md 'Workflows'); Renovate must move the SHA and the comment together.
Tool versions pinned in mise.toml ([tools] and per-task tools), read by Renovate's built-in mise manager.
The mise binary version pinned in the workflows via a '# renovate:' comment (see customManagers below).
Security fixes are not held back by the weekly window.
The Go directive in go.mod is pinned deliberately (PLAN.md 'Toolchain and local workflow'); bumping it is a reviewed change, not a routine PR.
Same rule for the Go toolchain in mise.toml: it must stay equal to the go directive in go.mod, so a bump updates go.mod and mise.toml in one reviewed change rather than a weekly PR.

customManagers.description: The mise binary version (MISE_VERSION in the workflows) is annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=jdx/mise' comment on the line above the value. Every other tool version lives in mise.toml and is handled by the mise manager.
